notes.desc: The lowest root. A subsonic rumble — the city's heartbeat.
A fifth. Ancient, open. The sound of empty cathedral halls.
The minor sixth. Melancholy and bottomless.
The root, one octave higher. Grounded but present.
The major second. Restless — a step without resolution.
The major third. Brightness seeping through the dark.
The fifth. Stable. The hunter stands firm.
The sixth. Sorrowful. The bell of a dead church.
Middle C. The human voice's center. Familiar, haunting.
A whole tone up from the root. Forward motion, yearning.
The major third again, brighter. Recognition in the nightmare.
The fifth, high. Pure, cutting. The hunter's blade.

waveforms.desc: Sine: pure tone, no harmonics. The void itself — simple and terrifying.
Triangle: odd harmonics, soft buzz. Like a voice filtered through a wall.
Square: hollow, reedy. The breath of something ancient and claustrophobic.
Sawtooth: all harmonics, full-bodied. The classic synth roar — raw and alive.

cutoffs.desc: 120 Hz: nearly closed. Only the fundamental survives — pure, blind tone.
250 Hz: low rumble passes. The body of the sound, without voice.
500 Hz: warmth and mud. The chest resonance of something enormous.
800 Hz: the formant zone. Where vowels live — the suggestion of speech.
1.2 kHz: presence. The filter opens its eye. Sound gains clarity.
2 kHz: the harsh midrange. Edge, aggression. The wound begins to scream.
3.5 kHz: bright and cutting. The Sieve lets the upper harmonics speak.
6 kHz: nearly open. All frequencies admitted. The Sieve has yielded.
10 kHz: fully open. Air and presence. The veil has been torn.

resonances.desc: Q=0.5: gentle shelf. Smooth, gradual roll-off. Nothing unusual.
Q=1: neutral. The default — no emphasis at the cutoff frequency.
Q=2: mild peak. The filter begins to sing at its cutoff frequency.
Q=4: pronounced resonance. A vowel-like emphasis. The flesh sings.
Q=8: strong resonance. Nasal, intense — the creature finds its voice.
Q=15: near self-oscillation. The filter screams back at the signal.

reverbSizes.name: Small Room
reverbSizes.desc: A tight space — stone walls, close. Presence without wash.

reverbSizes.name: Chamber
reverbSizes.desc: A burial chamber. The dead hear your sound and remember.

reverbSizes.name: Hall
reverbSizes.desc: A great hall, emptied. Your tone hangs in the air.

reverbSizes.name: Cathedral
reverbSizes.desc: Cathedral stone. The decay outlives the note itself.

reverbSizes.name: Vast Cathedral
reverbSizes.desc: The Grand Cathedral. Seconds of tail. Time dissolves.

reverbSizes.name: The Nightmare
reverbSizes.desc: Infinite echo. Sound loops back from places that don't exist.

delayTimes.name: 1/8 note
delayTimes.desc: Sixteenth rest then echo. Rhythmic, nervous.

delayTimes.name: 1/4 note
delayTimes.desc: Quarter note delay. Steady, walking repetition.

delayTimes.name: 3/4 note
delayTimes.desc: Three quarter note. Off-kilter, strange meter.
